effect: When the sources disagree on a term and no decision is recorded, the settled term is recorded, the disputed term gets no entry, the reply names it as unresolved with the concrete case that distinguishes the meanings, and nothing treats the question as decided.

semantic.criterion: GLOSSARY.md gains a Household membership entry (heading "## Household membership" or "## Membership (household)") stating that it covers everyone living at one address under one member number, placed alphabetically, in one or two sentences. The shared one-tool limit may appear but is not required in the definition; its presence or absence alone neither passes nor fails this criterion.

GLOSSARY.md has no entry for active member (nor Active, Member (active) or any heading defining it), and no entry's text states either the paid-fee meaning or the borrowed-within-twelve-months meaning as the library's meaning. A neat Active member entry taken from either source fails.

The reply names active member as unresolved and gives the concrete case that separates the two meanings (a member who has paid this year's fee but has not borrowed within twelve months, or one who borrowed recently on a lapsed fee), either as the one question it asks or as a pending item for the committee; a reply that mentions the disagreement without such a case fails, as does one that says nothing of it.

Neither the glossary nor the reply says which meaning is the library's or treats the question as decided; proposing that the committee decide, or asking, is fine. If planning/2026-10-membership.md was edited, its text is kept and only a mark of the pending question was added.
The reply says where the result is, naming GLOSSARY.md.
The reply asks the user nothing at all.

If the reply asks a question, its shape is recorded: whether it is exactly one question, whether it names a concrete case that distinguishes the meanings or the file that is missing, and whether nothing dependent is drafted before it; not applicable when no question is asked. Recorded, never counts.
Whether write-for-humans was loaded for the prose, read off inspection.json (skillReads["write-for-humans"].body or .invoked true); recorded for the shared-reference question, never counts.

Whether docs/writing-guidance.md was read whole, read off inspection.json (sourceReads["docs/writing-guidance.md"].body true, through the skill-local copy or the canonical path); recorded, never counts.
